title: Choosing Capital for Treeland
statementMd:
The country Treeland consists of $*n*$ cities, some pairs of them are connected with *unidirectional* roads. Overall there are $*n* - 1$ roads in the country. We know that if we don't take the direction of the roads into consideration, we can get from any city to any other one.

The council of the elders has recently decided to choose the capital of Treeland. Of course it should be a city of this country. The council is supposed to meet in the capital and regularly move from the capital to other cities (at this stage nobody is thinking about getting back to the capital from these cities). For that reason if city $*a*$ is chosen a capital, then all roads must be oriented so that if we move along them, we can get from city $*a*$ to any other city. For that some roads may have to be inversed.

Help the elders to choose the capital so that they have to inverse the minimum number of roads in the country.

## Input

The first input line contains integer $*n*$ ($2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$) — the number of cities in Treeland. Next $*n* - 1$ lines contain the descriptions of the roads, one road per line. A road is described by a pair of integers $*s*_{*i*}, *t*_{*i*}$ ($1 ≤ *s*_{*i*}, *t*_{*i*} ≤ *n*; *s*_{*i*} ≠ *t*_{*i*}$) — the numbers of cities, connected by that road. The $*i*$-th road is oriented from city $*s*_{*i*}$ to city $*t*_{*i*}$. You can consider cities in Treeland indexed from 1 to $*n*$.

## Output

In the first line print the minimum number of roads to be inversed if the capital is chosen optimally. In the second line print all possible ways to choose the capital — a sequence of indexes of cities in the increasing order.
statementZhMd:
<statement>
Treeland 由 $*n*$ 座城市组成，其中一些城市对之间由*单向*道路连接。这个国家总共有 $*n* - 1$ 条道路。已知如果不考虑道路的方向，可以从任意城市到达其他任意城市。

长老议会最近决定选出 Treeland 的首都。当然，首都应当是这个国家中的一座城市。议会计划在首都召开会议，并定期从首都前往其他城市（现阶段没有人考虑如何从这些城市返回首都）。因此，如果选择城市 $*a*$ 作为首都，那么所有道路都必须定向，使得沿着道路行驶时，可以从城市 $*a*$ 到达其他任意城市。为此，可能需要反转一些道路的方向。

请帮助长老们选择首都，使得需要反转的道路数量最少。

## 约束条件

## 输入格式

第一行包含一个整数 $*n*$（$2 ≤ *n* ≤ 2·10^{5}$），表示 Treeland 中城市的数量。接下来的 $*n* - 1$ 行包含道路的描述，每行一条道路。每条道路由一对整数 $*s*_{*i*}, *t*_{*i*}$（$1 ≤ *s*_{*i*}, *t*_{*i*} ≤ *n*; *s*_{*i*} ≠ *t*_{*i*}$）描述，表示由该道路连接的两座城市的编号。第 $*i*$ 条道路的方向为从城市 $*s*_{*i*}$ 指向城市 $*t*_{*i*}$。可以认为 Treeland 中的城市编号为 1 到 $*n*$。

## 输出格式

第一行输出在最优选择首都时需要反转的最少道路数量。第二行按编号递增的顺序输出所有可能的首都选择方案，即城市编号序列。
</statement>
